verificationAudit.observation: Canonical scope oracle passes, then incremental privacy check fails. Test requests TextBox; production ChatText creates RichTextBox with the same automation name.
verificationAudit.repair: Read all named RichTextBox FlowDocument TextRanges; require exact Partial visible text and reject internal in every rendered message and reply state. Maintained fixture still injects internal<say>Partial.

verificationAudit.observation: ChatState loaded before optional context lookup; UI had not projected settled scope.
verificationAudit.repair: Render settled chat before awaiting independent plan context, retaining original scope oracle.
Compile preflight before expensive interactive phases; reuse existing Elements<T> traversal.

packaging.dependencyClosure: Five pinned DLLs and two licenses, native loader and explicit Inno/packager closure.
packaging.inspectorCompatibility: PASS exact Inno 6.7 spanned fixture, extraction, legacy headers, truncation, corruption and bad-header controls.
packaging.realInstallerTest: NOT MEASURED: /tmp/wb-p005-content-inno-20261108-v2.log exited2 before test child started; install-reader lock timed out against active dependency writer. Prior v1 selected incompatible PATH inspector and is not passing packaging proof.

rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: The v4 incremental assertion fails because it requires the obsolete TextBox type.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The renderer leaks the injected private internal text.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: Collect every named native RichTextBox document. Require an exact Partial rendered message and reject internal in all rendered documents plus ChatReply.DisplayText.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: TextBox lookup fails while RichTextBox documents display Partial and exclude internal.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: At least one rendered document or reply state contains internal.

rootCauseVerification.actualObservation: Native chat v5 exits0 with all 26 assertions, including the strengthened rendered-document privacy check. Current content32, cards46 and lifecycle51 also pass.
